spec.outcome: Add a deterministic synthetic export option while preserving the existing API and human merge gate.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The export option produces deterministic output for the documented synthetic input.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: A fixed acceptance test passes at the exact draft pull-request head.
The fixed regression suite passes at the exact draft pull-request head.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Build emits only approved logical slots and trusted code creates only a draft pull request.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: The target-free patch and trusted draft pull-request evidence both validate.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Verification runs every fixed command and automated review emits COMMENT only.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: The exact-head verification report records all command IDs and a COMMENT review.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Completion requires an eligible independent human to accept the observed merged head.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: A separate synthetic-human continuation supplies current authorization and merge observation.

inScope: One export acceptance and regression test logical slot.
Draft pull-request delivery and exact-head COMMENT review.
outOfScope: Deployment, publication, or live Project administration.
Model-selected repository paths, commands, routes, effects, or credentials.
assumptions: The trusted binding and exact base SHA are supplied by conventional code.
All examples and tests use hermetic synthetic services.
